summary: A drum machine based on the Microtonic engine that can send kits, patterns and chains to a Microtonic-enabled Pocket Operator (PO-32). It also works as a standalone drum machine.
features: LAB pages edit each sound, with A and B patch sides
Imports Microtonic presets, drum patches and MIDI patterns; exports kits
Accent, mute, solo, pattern chains and punch-in effects
Brothers Link: Bluetooth sync with Chipbox and Smileyface
Standard MIDI clock in and out over USB
